mapper.select:
SELECT FROM T_ATM_STATUS
ORDER BY TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM T_ATM_STATUS WHERE TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND TERM_ID = #{termId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_ATM_STATUS T USING DUAL ON (T.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND T.TERM_ID = #{termId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SERVICE_STATUS = #{serviceStatus}, ATM_FAULT_STATUS = #{atmFaultStatus}, OP_FAULT_STATUS = #{opFaultStatus}, ERR_GROUP_CD = #{errGroupCd}, ERR_CD = #{errCd}, FAULT_ARISED_DATE = #{faultArisedDate}, FAULT_ARISED_TIME = #{faultArisedTime}, SVR_RECEIVE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), SVR_RECEIVE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), REMAIN_AMOUNT = #{remainAmount}, CHECK_AMOUNT = #{checkAmount} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, SERVICE_STATUS, ATM_FAULT_STATUS, OP_FAULT_STATUS, ERR_GROUP_CD, ERR_CD, SVR_RECEIVE_DATE, SVR_RECEIVE_TIME, REMAIN_AMOUNT, CHECK_AMOUNT) VALUES (#{termGroupId}, #{termId}, #{serviceStatus}, #{atmFaultStatus}, #{opFaultStatus}, #{errGroupCd}, #{errCd}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{remainAmount}, #{checkAmount})
